st: Put the bones in a pot, cover with water and boil 10 minutes. Drain, rinse the bones and scrub the pot.
Char the onion and ginger directly over a flame or under the broiler until blackened in spots, about 5 minutes.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon and cloves in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Return the bones to the pot with [[5 l]] water, brisket, onion, ginger and spices. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer uncovered for [[3 hours]], skimming the foam. Remove the brisket after 1 hour and slice it.
Strain the broth. Season with [[3 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[1 tbsp]] sugar and [[1 tbsp]] salt.
Soak the noodles in hot water for 20 minutes, then boil 1 to 2 minutes until tender. Drain.
Divide noodles between bowls and top with brisket and the raw sliced steak.
Pour boiling broth over the beef to cook it. Add cilantro, scallions, bean sprouts and lime.

ing: pork shoulder or tenderloin, sliced thin
st: Stir [[0.5 cup]] vinegar, [[0.5 cup]] warm water, [[2 tbsp]] sugar and [[1 tsp]] salt until dissolved. Add the carrot and daikon.
Let the vegetables pickle for [[30 minutes]].
Mix the pork with [[2 tbsp]] soy sauce, [[1 tbsp]] sugar and the garlic.
Heat [[1 tbsp]] oil in a skillet over high heat and cook the pork for 6 minutes until browned and cooked through to 145°F (63°C).
Warm the baguettes in a hot oven until crisp, then split them lengthwise.
Spread [[4 tbsp]] mayonnaise on one side and the pate on the other.
Fill with pork, drained pickles, cucumber, cilantro and chili.
Serve the sandwiches right away while the bread is crisp.
Mix the pork with [[2 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[2 tbsp]] sugar, half the garlic, the shallot and [[1 tsp]] pepper. Marinate for [[30 minutes]].
Make the dipping broth: stir [[4 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[3 tbsp]] sugar, juice of 2 limes and [[1 cup]] warm water until dissolved.
Add the remaining garlic and chili to the broth.
Shape the pork into small patties, or thread slices on skewers.
Grill or pan-sear for 4 minutes per side until browned and cooked to 160°F (71°C).
Boil the vermicelli for 4 minutes, rinse in cold water and drain.
Place grilled pork in the dipping broth.
Serve noodles, lettuce and herbs on the side for dipping and eating together.
Boil the vermicelli for 4 minutes, rinse in cold water and drain well.
Set out all the fillings in bowls and a wide plate of warm water.
Dip a rice paper in warm water for 5 seconds until just soft, and lay on a damp board.
Line up 3 shrimp halves near the edge, then top with pork slices.
Add lettuce, noodles, mint and a chive on top.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly like a burrito.
Mix [[0.25 cup]] hoisin, [[1 tbsp]] peanut butter and [[2 tbsp]] warm water, then top with [[0.25 cup]] peanuts.
Serve with the dipping sauce.
Soak the glass noodles in hot water for 10 minutes, drain and cut into short pieces.
Mix the pork, shrimp, carrot, noodles, onion, garlic, egg, [[1 tbsp]] fish sauce and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper.
Soften a rice paper in warm water for 5 seconds and place on a board.
Place about 2 tablespoons of filling near one corner.
Fold over the filling, tuck in the sides, and roll up tightly.
Repeat with the rest, keeping them from touching.
Heat [[3 cups]] oil to 340°F (170°C) in a deep pan.
Fry in batches for 8 minutes until golden and crisp and the pork reaches 160°F (71°C).
Drain on a rack and serve with lettuce, herbs and dipping sauce.

ing: pork hock or pork neck bones
st: Boil the beef and pork bones in water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse.
Return to a pot with [[4 l]] water, onion and 3 stalks bruised lemongrass. Simmer [[2 hours]], skimming.
Mince the remaining 2 lemongrass stalks.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil, fry the minced lemongrass and [[2 tbsp]] chili flakes for 2 minutes.
Mix [[1 tbsp]] shrimp paste with a ladle of water and add it to the pot, with the chili oil.
Add [[3 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[1 tbsp]] sugar and [[1 tsp]] salt. Simmer 20 minutes.
Remove the beef when tender, cool and slice thin.
Boil the noodles until soft, then drain.
Assemble noodles, beef and pork in bowls, ladle hot broth over, then top with herbs and lime.
Marinate the chops in [[2 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[2 tbsp]] sugar, the lemongrass and half the garlic for [[30 minutes]].
Rinse [[2 cups]] rice, add [[3 cups]] water and cook in a covered pot on low for [[15 minutes]] until tender.
Heat the grill or pan with [[1 tbsp]] oil.
Cook the chops 5 to 6 minutes per side until deep brown and 145°F (63°C) inside.
Fry the eggs in [[1 tbsp]] oil until the whites are set.
Warm the scallions in [[1 tbsp]] hot oil for 20 seconds to make scallion oil.
For the sauce, stir [[2 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[1 tbsp]] sugar, remaining garlic and [[0.5 cup]] warm water.
Plate rice with a chop, an egg, cucumber and tomato. Drizzle with scallion oil and sauce.
Whisk [[1.5 cups]] rice flour, [[1 cup]] coconut milk, [[1 cup]] water, [[1 tsp]] turmeric and [[0.5 tsp]] salt until smooth.
Stir in the scallions and rest the batter [[20 minutes]].
Heat [[1 tbsp]] oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook some pork slices and shrimp for 3 minutes until the pork is cooked.
Pour about [[0.75 cup]] batter into the pan and swirl it thin to coat.
Scatter bean sprouts over one half, cover and cook 3 minutes.
Uncover and cook another 3 minutes until the edges are crisp and golden.
Fold in half and slide to a plate. Repeat with the rest.
Wrap pieces in lettuce with herbs and dip in the sauce.
Marinate the fish in [[1 tbsp]] fish sauce, the garlic and [[1 tsp]] pepper for [[20 minutes]].
Heat [[1 tbsp]] oil in a clay pot or heavy pan and cook the shallots 3 minutes.
Add [[0.25 cup]] sugar and cook until dark amber, about 5 minutes, without stirring.
Carefully add [[0.5 cup]] water, stir and bring to a boil.
Add the fish and [[2 tbsp]] fish sauce, plus the chili. Add [[0.5 cup]] more water.
Simmer gently, turning the fish once, for [[30 minutes]] until the sauce is thick and syrupy and the fish is cooked.
Sprinkle the sliced scallions over the top.
Serve the fish and sauce with [[4 cups]] hot cooked rice.
Marinate the beef with the lemongrass, garlic, [[1 tbsp]] fish sauce and [[1 tbsp]] sugar for [[15 minutes]].
Boil the vermicelli for 4 minutes, rinse cold and drain.
Make the dressing: stir [[3 tbsp]] fish sauce, [[2 tbsp]] sugar, juice of 2 limes and [[0.25 cup]] warm water.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a wok over very high heat.
Stir-fry the beef for 3 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Divide lettuce, bean sprouts and herbs among bowls and top with noodles.
Top with the hot beef and drizzle with dressing.
Finish with [[0.25 cup]] peanuts.
Pour [[0.5 cup]] warm water into a bowl.
Add [[3 tbsp]] sugar and stir until it fully dissolves.
Stir in [[3 tbsp]] fish sauce.
Stir in [[3 tbsp]] lime juice.
Add the garlic and chili.
Taste and adjust: more sugar for sweeter, more lime for tangier.
Let it rest for [[5 minutes]] before serving with rolls, noodles or grilled meat.
Pour [[2 tbsp]] condensed milk into a heatproof glass.
Set a drip filter (phin) or small cone filter on top of the glass.
Add [[2 tbsp]] ground coffee and gently level it.
Pour in a little hot water to wet the grounds and wait 30 seconds.
Slowly add the remaining water from [[0.75 cup]] total, covering the filter.
Let it drip for about 5 minutes.
Stir the coffee and condensed milk together well.
Pour over [[1 cup]] ice in another glass and serve.
